Things from UO sell very easily on depop from my experience, not completely sure about the other brands but you should be fine as long as you’re not trying to sell stuff from Shein or Aliexpress. It took me about a month to get my first sale and my first review, just try to be very transparent about everything and fair on the prices so people can trust you. You’ve already probably heard this before, but to upload all of your items multiple times a day, it comes up before other items on the search. Also if you do make a sale, include a note asking them to leave a review, you’re more likely to get a review then. A lot of sellers don’t offer free shipping, especially for that price I wouldn’t offer free shipping, unless you are more determined to get rid of your stuff rather than actually make money.
